cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: For the Record
cards.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Before I show you the fireworks invoice, exactly what did you approve?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did you buy the enormous rocket?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. First, did your 'make it memorable' include rockets?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It included sparklers. Nothing that needed a trailer.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: When did you first mention the trailer limit? I need that date before we get to the delivery date.

mechanism: A controls the precision and order of an approval inquiry before exposing A's own fireworks purchase, using expert chronology to limit blame.
confusable: D174 hides the priority among blanks; D184 explicitly delays revealing A's involvement until B states their own authorization.
comparison: A spending limit and delivery dates differ from personal invitation boundaries.
seedUse: Keep memorable/sparklers/trailer limit, making A correct a real non-answer and then the newly stated restriction.
